content.overview: Relations resembling contract impose obligations: necessaries (s. 68), payment by interested persons (s. 69), non-gratuitous acts (s. 70), finder of goods (s. 71), and money paid by mistake or under coercion (s. 72).

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: Prevent unjust enrichment where no true contract exists. Each section has distinct ingredients.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Identify the exact section. For s. 72, prove payment under mistake or coercion and receipt by the defendant.
